name: Vera Wang
en:
Vera Ellen Wang (Chinese: 王薇薇; pinyin: Wáng Wēiwēi; born June 27, 1949) is an American fashion designer. Wang initially pursued a career in figure skating before transitioning to fashion. She got her start working for Vogue and Ralph Lauren before launching her own bridal gown boutique in 1990.
Wang has gained international recognition for her wedding gowns, which have been worn by numerous celebrities. She expanded her namesake brand to include ready-to-wear fashion, accessories, fragrances, and home goods. In 2024, Wang sold the brand to WHP Global.


== Early life ==
Vera Ellen Wang was born June 27, 1949, in New York City to Chinese parents who immigrated to the United States in the mid-1940s. Her mother, Florence Wu (Wu Chifang), was the daughter of the Fengtian Clique warlord Wu Junsheng and worked as a translator for the United Nations, while her father, Cheng Ching Wang (Wang Chengqing), a graduate of Yanjing University and MIT, owned a medicine company, and held the following positions: Director, Singapore Petroleum Company Pte. Ltd., Chairman & President, Oceanic Petroleum Corporation, Chairman & President, Oceanic Petroleum (Asia) Corporation, Chairman & President of Summit Group of Companies (now U.S. Summit Company), Chairman of the Vera Wang Group 1990-1998. Wang has one brother, Kenneth, who is a life member of MIT Corporation, a board of trustees that governs the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
Wang grew up on Manhattan's Upper East Side. She began figure skating at the age of eight, training under Peter Dunfield and Sonya Klopfer in Denver during the summers and with the Skating Club of New York during the rest of the year. While in high school, she trained with pairs partner James Stuart, and competed at the 1968 U.S. Figure Skating Championships. She was featured in Sports Illustrated's Faces in the Crowd in the January 9, 1968 issue. Recalling her efforts to make the U.S. Olympics team, she said, "I was devastated when I did not qualify for the Olympic team." Then she entered the fashion industry. Wang continues to enjoy skating, saying it is “multidimensional.”
Wang attended Friends Seminary, graduated from Chapin School in 1967, attended the University of Paris, and earned a degree in art history from Sarah Lawrence College. In 2013, she was the keynote speaker at Sarah Lawrence’s 85th commencement ceremony.
In 1968, Wang was presented as a debutante to high society at the International Debutante Ball at the Waldorf Astoria New York.


== Career ==
Wang was hired to be an editor at Vogue upon graduation from Sarah Lawrence College, making her the youngest editor at that magazine. She stayed at Vogue for 17 years, leaving in 1987 to join Ralph Lauren, for whom she worked for two years. At 40, she resigned and became an independent bridal wear designer.

Wang has made wedding gowns for public figures such as Hayley Williams, Vanessa Hudgens, Chelsea Clinton, Karenna Gore, Ivanka Trump, Campbell Brown, Alicia Keys, Mariah Carey, Victoria Beckham, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Avril Lavigne, Hilary Duff, Khloe Kardashian, and Kim Kardashian. Wang started off as being  best known for her elegant wedding dresses. Wang's evening wear has also been worn by Michelle Obama.
Figure skaters who have worn costumes designed by Wang at the Winter Olympic Games include Nancy Kerrigan (1992 and 1994), Michelle Kwan (1998 and 2002), Evan Lysacek (2010), and Nathan Chen (2018 and 2022). Wang was inducted into the U.S. Figure Skating Hall of Fame in 2009 for her contribution to the sport as a costume designer. She designed the uniforms worn by the Philadelphia Eagles Cheerleaders.
On October 23, 2001, her book Vera Wang on Weddings was released. In June 2005, she won the Council of Fashion Designers of America (CFDA) Womenswear Designer of the Year.  On May 27, 2006, Wang was awarded the André Leon Talley Lifetime Achievement Award from the Savannah College of Art and Design.
Wang's evening wear has been worn by stars at many red carpet events, including Viola Davis at the 2012 Academy Awards, and Sofia Vergara at the 65th Emmy Awards.
She was awarded the Council of Fashion Designers of America Lifetime Achievement Award in 2013.
In 2006, Wang reached a deal with Kohl's, a chain of department stores, to produce a less expensive line of ready-to-wear clothing exclusively for them called Simply Vera.
Forbes placed her the 34th in the list America's Richest Self-Made Women 2018, her revenues rising to $630 million in that year.
On September 10, 2019, after a sabbatical of two years during which she had presented her collections only via films, Vera Wang returned to the New York Fashion Week runway for her Spring/Summer 2020 fashion show, which celebrated the 30th anniversary of her brand. The show received very positive reviews, with Godfrey Deeny describing it as a "notable collection by one of the few New York designers with a truly distinctive fashion DNA", while Bridget Foley presented Wang's creations as "Beautiful, seriously designed clothes, presented with gutsy panache". However, the show was marred by several major footwear malfunctions, especially during the finale when four models fell down, including Fei Fei Sun, who fell twice in a row, leading chief fashion critic Vanessa Friedman to state that "In 2019, no woman should be tortured by what she wears".
In December 2024, WHP Global, a brand management firm based in New York, announced an agreement to acquire the IP of the Vera Wang fashion brand. As part of the transaction, Wang agreed to continue in the role as Founder & Chief Creative Officer, joining WHP Global as a shareholder.


== Retail ==
In 1990, Wang opened her first design salon in the Carlyle Hotel in New York City that features her trademark bridal gowns. She has since opened bridal boutiques in New York, London, Tokyo, and Sydney and has also expanded her brand through her fragrance, jewelry, eyewear, shoes, and homeware collections.
"White by Vera Wang" launched on February 11, 2011, at David's Bridal. Prices of the bridal gowns range from $600 to $1,400. The partnership ended in 2020 when COVID briefly knocked the wind out of the bridal industry. In 2002, Wang began to enter the home fashion industry and launched The Vera Wang China and Crystal Collection, followed by the 2007 release of her diffusion line called Simply Vera, which are sold exclusively by Kohl's.

In spring 2012, Wang teamed up with Men's Wearhouse to offer two tuxedo styles available in both the retail and rental areas of their inventory.
In June 2012, she expanded in Australia with the opening of "Vera Wang Bride Sydney" and her first Asian flagship store "Vera Wang Bridal Korea", helmed by President Jung Mi-ri, in upmarket neighborhood Cheongdam-dong in Gangnam-gu, Seoul.
In a 2013 interview with CBS, Wang described her transition from journalist to businesswoman as "painful, and not only that, I have no choice. So I think when you start there's a certain innocence because of that freedom, and as you evolve you begin to see the parameters of what you can and can't do. So I make decisions that are very tiny that will affect an hour of work, I make decisions that will impact the lives of the people that work for me. It's in fashion as well, micro work, a centimeter of proportion and then it's macro to see what a vision is on the red carpet."


== Business ==


=== Brand Expansion and Licensing ===
Vera Wang has expanded her namesake brand beyond custom couture through global licensing, retail collaborations, and regional manufacturing agreements.


==== Bridal and Apparel ====
In April 2021, Vera Wang signed a 10-year global licensing agreement with the Barcelona-based Pronovias Group to produce and distribute her Vera Wang Bride diffusion line. The inaugural collection debuted in September 2021 with 60 wedding gowns, followed by occasion wear, headpieces, and accessories in early 2022.
Following financial restructuring and a shift in ownership of Pronovias Group from BC Partners to Bain Capital and MV Credit in early 2023, the group refocused on its core European brands. In September 2025, midway through the original 10-year term, Pronovias transferred the manufacturing, wholesale, and global distribution rights for the Vera Wang Bride label to David's Bridal. David's Bridal, which had previously carried the White by Vera Wang line for over a decade, assumed full global operation of the brand, launching its inaugural collection under the deal in April 2026.


==== Regional Collaborations ====
In 2026, Vera Wang expanded her ready-to-wear offerings in Greater China through both direct distribution and designer collaborations. In addition to launching a dedicated regional ready-to-wear line on Tmall, Wang partnered with China-based designer incubator Fabrique for a limited-edition capsule collection featuring tailoring, outerwear, and contemporary separates.
In January 2026, Vera Wang announced a partnership with the Batra Group to launch a new ready-to-wear line tailored for the UK and European markets, expanding her brand beyond bridal and occasion wear in the region.
In May 2026, Vera Wang announced its first systematic ready-to-wear expansion for the Chinese market, debuting a China-exclusive ready-to-wear collection launched via its Tmall flagship store. The collection adapts the brand's signature monochrome aesthetic and couture tailoring into daily wear, covering categories for business commuting, social occasions, and formal wear, with plans for subsequent offline retail expansion in mainland China.
In August 2026, Vera Wang partnered with Chinese women's footwear brand Staccato to launch a dual footwear collection spanning bridal heels, evening pumps, platform loafers, and athletic sneakers.


==== Fragrances ====
Vera Wang entered the fragrance industry in 2002 with the release of her debut signature scent, Vera Wang for Women, created in partnership with Unilever Cosmetics International (UCI). In July 2005, global beauty conglomerate Coty Inc. acquired Unilever's prestige fragrance portfolio, assuming long-term licensing, manufacturing, and distribution rights for all Vera Wang fragrances.
In 2006, Coty and Wang introduced Vera Wang Princess, a fruity-floral fragrance targeted at a younger demographic that became one of the brand's core commercial pillars. The Princess franchise birthed several spin-off scents and flankers:

Rock Princess: Originally launched in April 2009 as a dark fruity-floral variant of the original Princess fragrance. In April 2023, Coty and Wang officially relaunched Rock Princess with a modernized formulation, dark raspberry and jasmine notes, and updated studded packaging.
Additional major fragrance lines under the brand include:

Lovestruck (2011): A romance-themed fragrance line fronted by actress Leighton Meester, which spawned flankers such as Lovestruck Floral Rush (2012) prior to the line being phased out of production.
Vera Wang Embrace (2015): A body mist and fragrance collection developed for mass retail distribution.
Vera Wang Love (2025): Released in May 2025, Vera Wang Love Eau de Parfum was introduced as a white floral and woody fragrance drawing inspiration from the designer's heritage in luxury bridal couture.


== Personal life ==
In June 1989, Wang married investor Arthur P. Becker in an interfaith Baptist and Jewish ceremony. They have two daughters, both of whom were adopted. In July 2012, the couple announced their separation.


== In popular culture ==
Several movies and television shows have featured Wang's works, including The West Wing, The Newsroom, Gossip Girl, Sex and the City, Revenge, The Simpsons, and the film Sex and the City.
Wang appeared in a cameo in season 5 episode 11 of the TV series Gossip Girl and as herself in the second season of Ugly Betty in episode 2.07.


== Filmography ==


=== Movies ===

The September Issue (2009) as herself.

Keeping Up with the Kardashians  (2011) as herself.

== Recognition ==
She was recognized as one of the BBC's 100 women of 2021.
In 2023, she received the Board of Directors' Tribute at the 2023 CFDA Fashion Awards for her Bridal impact.

zh:
王薇薇（英語：Vera Wang；1949年6月27日—），美國華裔時尚設計師，主要活躍在紐約市。


== 早年履歷 ==
王薇薇出生於美國紐約市的一個華裔家庭，並在紐約市長大；她出生時所使用的英文名為Vera Ellen Wang。王薇薇的父母都出生於中國，並於1940年代中期移民至美國。王薇薇的父親王澄清畢業於燕京大學和麻省理工學院，擁有一家醫藥公司；母親吳赤芳曾經在聯合國擔任翻譯。而王薇薇的外祖父是奉系軍閥的吳俊陞，於1928年的皇姑屯事件中被日本關東軍暗殺。王薇薇還有一個弟弟，名叫肯尼斯·王（Kenneth Wang）。
王薇薇曾就讀於友誼學校，並在1967年從查賓學校畢業。高中畢業後，她就讀於巴黎大學並在莎拉·勞倫斯學院獲得美術史學位。
王薇薇從8歲的時候就開始學習花式滑冰。在高中時代，她與詹姆士·斯圖亞特（James Stuart）成為雙人滑搭檔並一起接受訓練。他倆曾參加過1968年的美國花式滑冰錦標賽；並在1968年1月9日，王薇薇登上了《體育畫報》的「芸芸眾生」版。由於未能入選美國國奧隊，她轉投時尚行業。不過時至今日，王薇薇依舊享受滑冰的樂趣，並表示「滑冰是多方面的」。
1968年，在紐約華爾道夫酒店舉辦的國際元媛舞會上，王薇薇首次亮相於上流社會。


== 職業生涯 ==

王薇薇剛從莎拉·勞倫斯學院畢業就被聘為《時尚》雜誌的編輯，這使得她成為《時尚》史上最年輕的編輯。她在《時尚》工作了17年，於1987年辭職並加入到拉爾夫·勞倫並在那工作了2年。當王薇薇40歲的時候，她辭職成為獨立的新娘婚紗設計師。她設計名單中的公眾人物包括：切爾西·柯林頓、卡蕾娜·戈爾、伊萬卡·川普、坎貝爾·布朗、艾莉西亞·凱斯、瑪麗亞·凱莉、維多利亞·貝克漢姆、莎拉·蜜雪兒·吉蘭、艾薇兒·拉維尼、希拉蕊·朵芙、科勒·卡戴珊、金·卡戴珊等人。米歇爾·歐巴馬也穿過王薇薇所設計的晚禮服。
她也曾經為花式滑冰運動員設計表演服，這其中包括南茜·克里根、關穎珊、埃文·萊薩塞克和陳巍等。王薇薇分別設計了南茜·克里根在1992年和1994年冬奧會的服裝；關穎珊在1998年和2002年冬奧會的服裝；埃文·萊薩塞克在2010年冬奧會的服裝以及陳巍在2018年和2022年冬奧會的服裝。王薇薇因為在服裝設計方面對花式滑冰運動的貢獻而在2009年入選美國花式滑冰名人堂。同時，王薇薇還為費城老鷹啦啦隊設計了制服。
在許多紅毯走秀環節上，明星們也熱衷於穿著王薇薇所設計的禮服。薇拉·戴維絲在2012年奧斯卡金像獎紅毯以及蘇菲亞·薇格拉在第65屆黃金時段艾美獎紅毯上都是穿著她的設計。
2001年10月23日，王薇薇的個人著作《王薇薇：完美婚禮》出版。2005年6月，她榮膺美國時裝設計師協會「年度女裝設計師」稱號；2006年5月27日，她獲得了薩凡納藝術設計學院「安德烈·萊昂·塔利終身成就獎」；2013年，王薇薇被美國時裝設計師協會授予「終身成就獎」。
2006年，王薇薇與連鎖百貨商科爾氏達成一項合作協議，為它們提供一條平價成衣產品線，該品牌被命名為「簡薇（Simply Vera）」。2018年，《福布斯》雜誌將其列為「2018年美國白手起家女性富豪榜」的第34位，當時她的收入已經增至6.3億美元。
在持續2年僅僅通過視頻介紹自己設計系列的休假期後，王薇薇於2019年9月10日回歸紐約時裝周，公開在其品牌的2020年春夏款走秀中亮相，以慶祝她的品牌成立30周年。這次走秀獲得了大量積極評價，戈德弗雷·蒂尼（Godfrey Deeny）將其描述為「少數幾個擁有真正獨特時尚基因的紐約設計師之一所締造的著名系列」，而布里奇特·福利（Bridget Foley）則將王薇薇的設計形容為「以勇敢的姿態所呈現的美麗而精心設計的服裝」。但是這場秀的完美卻受到了幾次鞋品故障的破壞，特別是在結尾部分，有不少於四名模特兒因此而摔倒。這其中也包括頂級超模孫菲菲，她在走秀中曾兩次摔倒。知名時尚評論員凡妮莎·費爾德曼對此評論道，「都已經是2019年了，任何女人都不該因為自己的穿著而遭受酷刑。」


=== 主要產業 ===
1990年，王薇薇在紐約市的卡萊爾酒店創立了自己的設計沙龍，並在此出售她的品牌婚紗。此後，王薇薇在紐約、倫敦、東京和悉尼都開設了她的婚紗專賣店，同時她的經營範圍也擴展到香水、珠寶、眼鏡和家庭用品等。
2002年，王薇薇開始涉足家庭時尚行業，並推出了「王薇薇瓷器與水晶系列（The Vera Wang China and Crystal Collection）」。2007年，王薇薇與科爾氏合作了她的首個品牌副線——「簡薇（Simply Vera）」，該系列僅在科爾氏出售。「純白王薇薇（White by Vera Wang）」於2011年2月11日在大衛新娘創立，這是王薇薇品牌的副線品牌。這個品牌的婚紗售價從600美元到1400美元不等，這使得更多新娘可以以更平價的方式穿著王薇薇所設計的婚紗。
2012年春季，王薇薇與男士衣坊達成合作，以零售或租借鋪位的形式出售無尾禮服。同年6月，王薇薇在澳大利亞開設了「王薇薇新娘雪梨店」；並在韓國開設了她的首家亞洲旗艦店「王薇薇新娘首爾店」。
在2024年12月，75歲的王薇薇將她創立已有35年的同名品牌出售給了WHP Global。根據收購協議，王薇薇將繼續以設計總監的身份留任，為品牌的創意方向提供指導。


== 個人生活 ==
1989年，王薇薇嫁給了亞瑟·貝克爾，這是一場浸禮宗與猶太教的異教婚姻。他們與他們所領養的兩個女兒居住於曼哈頓，大女兒塞西莉亞（Cecilia）出生於1990年，目前已分家另過於紐約市；小女兒約瑟芬（Josephine）出生於1993年，自查賓學校畢業後，目前就讀於哈佛大學。貝克爾曾是一家信息技術服務公司導航站的執行長，但於2010年8月離職。2012年7月，王薇薇公司發表聲明，宣布兩人已經友好分手。
王薇薇熱愛運動和鍛鍊。她每天忙於處理自己名下不同系列的產品，從細心研究瓷器圖案到科爾氏的小型皮革產品。她通常在白天的時候不接聽電話。


== 跨界經歷 ==
美國的數部影視作品及電視節目裡都有提及王薇薇或有她出鏡。
在電視劇版的《慾望城市》裡，女主角之一的夏綠蒂·約克發現王薇薇所設計的婚紗是最完美的婚紗，因而在她與特瑞·麥克道格爾（Trey MacDougal）的婚禮上選擇穿著她的設計。在NBC電視網首播的電視劇《白宮風雲》中，她的設計也在第三季第19集的「黑色婚紗」中被提及。而在ABC電視網播出的電視劇《醜女貝蒂》中，王薇薇更是親自出鏡，她在劇中為威廉米娜·斯萊特（Wilhelmina Slater）設計了她與布拉德福德·米德（Bradford Meade）婚禮上的禮服。
